acceptanceCriteria: Successful events remain recorded independently from failed or not_attempted source coverage.
HTTP 429 indicates data-health failure only and never proves event absence.
Complete Partial and Unavailable Supply Observation states are distinct.
Missing or None data is non-healthy or unknown and never becomes zero events.
Partial results retain observed positive events and never claim the overall state is risk-free.
A single run uses one shared collection snapshot identity across its consumers.
Recovery between runs does not leak stale prior-run state.
Decision Gate Risk Execution and PositionSizing outputs remain unchanged.
goal: Make capital-absorption Supply Observation distinguish provider failure from event absence and missing data from negative facts while preserving every Decision/Gate/Risk/Execution/PositionSizing output.
intent: 修复 Supply Observation 的数据可用性语义，使 Provider Failure 不等于 Event Absence、Missing 不等于 Negative，同时保持交易逻辑不变。
outOfScope: No changes outside the fourteen listed paths
No changes to Decision Gate Risk Execution or PositionSizing logic or outputs
No live provider calls no Telegram sends and no trades
Do not overwrite original raw-data reports
